result.topic_en: Notes on the energy (vis viva) integral and the stability of equilibrium for a system of particles, using the maximum of the force function P, Gauss's principle of least constraint, and the elasticity of solid bodies under molecular and external forces.

methods.what: Energy (vis viva) integral for a conservative system with force function P
Gauss-type minimum principle (least constraint) in terms of velocity increments and force function
Stability of equilibrium where P is maximal: P−U as function of deviation coordinates, negative except at equilibrium
Energy bound confining the deviations within their limits (Lagrange–Dirichlet stability argument)
Force components on particle ι as molecular force plus external force
